text: The town gathers

Haiku, the doctor, was voted out on day one, and Sol, the mayor, led that vote and later regretted it. Gemma then claimed to be the officer and called Luna a killer, but Luna claimed officer too and said Gemma was the killer, and Gemma's account of who she had checked kept shifting. Sol died overnight while Terra stayed quiet and Luna sold her officer bluff, so the town voted Gemma out on day two. The killers, Luna and Terra, won.
